answer: Because each ledge escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the river ledger records every share and the bridge audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 95 aliases means 95 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
